_readme: Authored content for Batch heritage_tree_services_20260916 (rule 18: content as data, never ad-hoc writes).
One entry per sighted invoice. Each coding_note RESTATES what the invoice face prints for that document
(contract, blanket order, proposal number, site address, customer request number, printed PK, service
point and the priced lines) and states whether the printed PK equals the PK charged. No amount is
inferred: every figure is the printed one, and the corpus gates GREEN with all 26 documents at TIE.
nature_category and theme_v3 are CARRIED FROM THE REGISTER ROW, not decided here: a capture build proves
what a document says and is not a re-categorisation build. The register's Heritage lines carry Nature
Category 'Tree operations' on 409 of 410 lines and Theme group (v3 L1) '10 Trees & natural areas'; the
level-2 category that maps to that group in Theme_Map_v3 is 'Trees & arboriculture', which is the value
theme_v3 takes. The one register line carrying 'Contract mowing' is recorded as an open question in
corroboration_techone_images_20260916.md and is NOT corrected here.
22 of the 26 were corroborated on 16-Sep-2026 against their TechOne C-images, every figure to the cent.
